These pressure zones work together to provide a comprehensive massage experience that can be customized to meet the individual needs of each user. The ultimate goal of this inventive technology is to relieve leg pain and discomfort without causing any adverse side effects. By promoting muscular relaxation and improving blood circulation, the SoleFlux Relax can help to reduce fatigue, improve mobility, and provide relief for people suffering from various leg conditions such as edema, varicose veins, and chronic pain.
